$comment: Single source of truth for the posterly MCP tool surface: which set each tool belongs to, its human label, its views/actions (sub tools), confirm level, and annotation hints, plus renamed-tool aliases. Loaded by mcp-server/src/index.ts (stdio) and lib/mcp/tool-registry.ts (hosted); checked by scripts/check-mcp-tool-design.ts. Rules: docs/mcp-tool-design.md. Param-driven modes (for example update_post status vs content edits) are still recorded as views/actions so the action count is derived from this file. Aliases may add `mode` to force a param-driven mode, and param specs may be `nullable`. A param-driven mode is chosen by its `when` params.
